page.overview:
Who is Telumehtar?

Telumehtar, also known as Telumehtar Umbardacil, was the twenty-eighth King of Gondor. He is most famous for his victory over the Corsairs of Umbar in TA 1810.

Telumehtar succeeded his father Tarondor as King in TA 1798. Early in his reign, the Corsairs of Umbar raided the coasts of Gondor and terrorized shipping in the Bay of Belfalas. King Telemnar had been preparing an expedition to avenge the death of his father Minardil, but the outbreak of the Great Plague sapped Gondor's strength. 174 years later, Telumehtar resolved to end the war and gain vengeance, so he assembled a large force in TA 1810 and recaptured the city of Umbar. After this event he took the title Umbardacil, meaning "Victor over Umbar". In this war, the Corsairs suffered total defeat and the descendants of Castamir the Usurper all perished. Umbar was for a time held again by Gondor.

Telumehtar ruled for fifty-two years. He had two sons: his eldest, Narmacil II (who succeeded him in TA 1850), and his younger son Arciryas.
